source_level_chain: CPO loads masks/refs on CPU and derives CPU int64 flat indices.
In each _compute_loss, before partition filtering, CPO copies the full global flat_idx and full global ref vector to param.device.
For ZeRO-3 it also executes param.ds_tensor.to(param.device).float() on the full local parameter partition.
CPO then stores rank-local global_idx and grad back on CPU in _pending_mask_grads; the gradient hook copies both back to grad.device.
CPO public zero3_offload config sets parameter offload to CPU with pinned memory.

DeepSpeed 0.16.4 propagates offload_param_config.device into DeepSpeedZeRoOffload.offload_device, passes it as Init(remote_device=...), and creates non-persistent ds_tensor partitions on remote_device; therefore non-persistent parameter ds_tensor is CPU under this public config.

DeepSpeed local_device is the accelerator device and partitioned param.data is freed to an empty tensor on its existing param.device; CPO's param.device therefore targets the accelerator for the public ZeRO-3 path.

Transformers 4.57.3 resolves stage3_param_persistence_threshold='auto' to 10*hidden_size. Qwen3-VL-4B hidden_size=2560 => threshold 25,600 scalars, so major weight matrices are non-persistent/offloaded; small norms/biases may stay persistent.

symbols.N: full scalar count of one non-persistent masked parameter
symbols.s: global protected positions for that parameter

transfer_model.note: This counts tensor payload traffic implied by explicit .to/.cpu calls and BF16 ds_tensor size. It excludes allocator metadata, protocol overhead, asynchronous overlap and any caching not present in the shown CPO source.

qwen3vl4b_10pct_full_nonpersistent_scena.scope: Upper-style projection treating the full canonical parameter domain as non-persistent and at exactly 10% support. Small persistent parameters and real support distribution reduce/alter this. This is not a measured PCIe/NVLink trace.

cpu_local_partitioned_regularizer.idea: Precompute rank-local mask indices/ref slices once; compute diff/sign against CPU-offloaded ds_tensor locally on CPU, then transfer only rank-local pending idx+grad to the accelerator hook.
cpu_local_partitioned_regularizer.per_rank_per_call_payload: 12*ceil(s/W) H2D bytes if both int64 idx and fp32 grad are transferred in the hook

cache_rank_local_indices_on_accelerator.idea: If GPU memory permits, cache rank-local indices once and transfer only fp32 gradient values each call after CPU-side diff/sign.

scope: Source-level transfer accounting only; no CUDA/DeepSpeed profiler trace was executed in this environment.
The model-wide Qwen projection assumes full 10% support and treats all canonical scalars as non-persistent; real support and persistence must be measured.
CPU-side regularizer computation may have its own latency/vectorization costs and must be profiled before adoption.
The CPO paper-table implementation may differ from the current public release.
This transfer issue is separate from the previously identified 1/world_size regularizer attenuation, paper-vs-code TopP/normalization mismatch, tied-alias bookkeeping, and dense-mask lifetime.
